video_title: Indiana Pacers Mexico City Practice Media Availability | November 6, 2026

quotes.speaker: Aaron Nesmith
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Nesmith on the importance of international games for global growth
quotes.excerpt: For these kids to be able to see us play in front of them and come to their home country, it's awesome.
quotes.quote: I think it's huge. Even being from the US, I didn't get the chance to see NBA players as a kid. For these kids to be able to see us play in front of them and come to their home country, it's awesome.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Nesmith on the NBA playing in Mexico City: It is huge. For these kids to be able to see us play in front of them and come to their home country, it is awesome.

structured.context: Aaron Nesmith discusses the importance of the NBA playing international games in Mexico City.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Nesmith
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Nesmith on playing without Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.excerpt: We've been here before. We know what we need to do to get up out of this.
quotes.quote: We've been here before. He missed the entirety of last season. We started last season hurt amongst ourselves. On top of that, this year we started hurt. So, we've been here before. We know what we need to do to get up out of this. We know we got to lean on one another, play hard, and try and stay afloat as long as we can until we can get our leader back.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Nesmith on playing without Tyrese Haliburton: We have been here before. He missed the entirety of last season. We know we have to lean on one another and try to stay afloat as long as we can until we can get our leader back.

structured.context: Aaron Nesmith discusses how the team is managing the absence of Tyrese Haliburton due to injury.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on dealing with early season injuries
quotes.excerpt: At least it's right now and we can get guys back and get healthy.
quotes.quote: It's been tough for us. Obviously we had a lot of injuries and it happens in the league all over the place, but it's kind of hard when you have to deal with them super early on in the season. But again, at least it's right now and we can get guys back and get healthy and we started getting guys back already. So we just want to continue to have guys back and play at full strength.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam on the Pacers early season injury struggles: It is kind of hard when you have to deal with them super early on in the season. But at least it is right now and we can get guys back and get healthy.

structured.context: Pascal Siakam reflects on the team dealing with multiple injuries early in the season.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on facing Nikola Jokic and the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: They've won at the highest level already before and they have obviously Jokic and a great team.
quotes.quote: It's a good, really good team. Obviously they've won at the highest level already before and they have obviously Jokic and a great team, Jamal and all the guys over there. So it's going to be a fun, fun game and we're excited for the matchup and the challenge.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam on facing the Nuggets: It is a good, really good team. Obviously they have won at the highest level already before and they have Jokic and a great team. It is going to be a fun game.

structured.context: Pascal Siakam previews the upcoming game against the Denver Nuggets and their star players.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. on team preparation for Mexico City altitude
quotes.excerpt: Coach made it a point to open up our lungs, so we did some sprints.
quotes.quote: Practice was amazing. Coach made it a point to open up our lungs, so we did some sprints, we did a lot of running, things to stay active and just kind of break in our bodies for this altitude. But at the end of the day, tomorrow is a beautiful opportunity for us to win a basketball game and play against a great team.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. on preparing for the Mexico City altitude: Coach made it a point to open up our lungs, so we did some sprints, we did a lot of running, things to stay active and just kind of break in our bodies for this altitude.

structured.context: Kelly Oubre Jr. describes how the team prepared for the high altitude in Mexico City during practice.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. on the challenge of facing Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: Do our best job to slow down the four-time, however many time MVP that these guys won.
quotes.quote: Do our best job to slow down the four-time, however many time MVP that these guys won. He's one of the best players to ever touch the basketball. He has a great supporting cast around him, so it's up to us to be locked in and be focused on the details.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. on facing Nikola Jokic: Do our best job to slow down the MVP. He is one of the best players to ever touch the basketball. It is up to us to be locked in and be focused on the details.

structured.context: Kelly Oubre Jr. discusses the defensive challenge of facing Nikola Jokic.

quotes.speaker: Ivica Zubac
quotes.summary_phrase: Ivica Zubac on the effectiveness of NBA players in European leagues
quotes.excerpt: Some of the player's game style doesn't fit well with a European basketball since it's just a different game.
quotes.quote: It depends. It depends. It's a totally different game, so it depends on the game style of the player. Some of the player's game style doesn't fit well with a European basketball since it's just a different game, but I would say definitely the best league is NBA.
quotes.social_post: Ivica Zubac on European basketball: It depends on the game style of the player. Some of the player's game style does not fit well with European basketball since it is just a different game, but the best league is definitely the NBA.

structured.context: Ivica Zubac shares his perspective on the differences between playing in the NBA and European leagues.

quotes.speaker: Ivica Zubac
quotes.summary_phrase: Ivica Zubac on the impact of playing in Denver's altitude
quotes.excerpt: It was already tough playing in Denver, so this being higher is definitely going to be something.
quotes.quote: It was already tough playing in Denver, so this being higher is definitely going to be something that's we got to think about, something that's going to bother us, but you got to push through it and play through it, play hard.
quotes.social_post: Ivica Zubac on the altitude in Mexico City: It was already tough playing in Denver, so this being higher is definitely something that is going to bother us, but you have to push through it and play hard.

structured.context: Ivica Zubac comments on the physical challenge of playing in high-altitude environments.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton's injury status
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese will be back, hopefully before too long. Unfortunately he's not able to be here.
quotes.quote: Tyrese will be back, hopefully before too long. Unfortunately he's not able to be here. He sends his regards to Mexico. He's very disappointed he couldn't make it, but it's better for his rehab to stay at home and to be in the hyperbaric and do all the treatment and stuff.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton: Tyrese will be back, hopefully before too long. It is better for his rehab to stay at home and to be in the hyperbaric and do all the treatment and stuff.

structured.context: Rick Carlisle provides an update on Tyrese Haliburton's injury recovery and why he did not travel to Mexico City.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on the Pacers' mental health resources
quotes.excerpt: We've got a full-time sports psychologist named Dr. Jamie Rubin who does a great job.
quotes.quote: The Indiana Pacers have great resources for mental health. We've got a full-time sports psychologist named Dr. Jamie Rubin who does a great job. She's amazing and we just have we have a lot of support from top to bottom in the organization. When players are injured or go through difficult situations, communication is very important and they need to know that you care and we care very, very deeply about our team.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle on the Pacers mental health resources: We have a full-time sports psychologist named Dr. Jamie Rubin who does a great job. When players are injured, communication is very important and they need to know that we care.

structured.context: Rick Carlisle highlights the mental health resources provided by the Indiana Pacers organization.
